scope: All original src files and their direct build, test and documentation references
execution: Apply every relocation, rename and reference update before compilation or tests; repair failures directly against the complete result.
preserve: Host-required plugin filenames and resource bytes

apply.details: Use final destinations in file-map.json directly; remove only the mapped empty src/core/mod.rs.
Create owner entries and update declarations, imports, re-exports, visibility, macro paths and Rustdoc references. Do not retain old-path forwarding modules.
Update include_str/include_bytes resource paths, test imports, TypeScript roots, Android typecheck staging and source navigation links.

verify_after_complete: Check all mapped destinations, obsolete paths, destination uniqueness and SHA-256 preservation of non-Rust assets.
Run cargo check --all-targets --locked, just ci fmt clippy test, and just ci typecheck against the completed layout.
Run the relevant Rust integration suites separately if unit failures prevent Cargo from reaching them.
Use just package to build .bin/agentx and check its version.
Inspect the diff for unintended behavior changes and confirm root plugin/ and skills/ remain unchanged.
failure_handling: Diagnose failures, directly fix migration-induced issues, then rerun only affected checks. When a failure also reproduces on the original baseline, record it without changing unrelated behavior.
